label: Niño 3.4 Monitoring Region
sub: TAO/TRITON moored buoy array tracking the primary ENSO SST index region; anomaly reached +1.8°C by late June 2026.

label: Galápagos Islands
sub: Warm-water upwelling disruption threatens endemic marine species reliant on the cool Humboldt/Cromwell current system.

label: Chimbote, Peru
sub: Peru's largest fishmeal port saw anchovy landings collapse as warm coastal waters dispersed stocks northward and to depth.

label: Callao, Peru
sub: Major fishing port reporting steep declines in anchovy processing volumes tied to the 2026 anchovy fishing suspension.

label: Piura, Peru
sub: Northern coastal region historically hit hardest by Coastal El Niño flooding during 1997-98 and 2017; monitored for renewed flood risk.

label: Murray-Darling Basin, Australia
sub: Australia's key agricultural basin faces elevated drought risk as El Niño historically brings reduced rainfall to eastern Australia.

label: Great Barrier Reef, Australia
sub: Marine heatwave conditions raise coral bleaching risk on a reef system still recovering from prior bleaching events.

label: Central Kalimantan, Indonesia
sub: Peatland fires among the regions driving Indonesia's 96,000+ fire hotspot count by late July 2026.

label: Riau, Sumatra, Indonesia
sub: 48,890 hectares of peatland ablaze, among the largest concentrations of 2026 fire hotspots on Sumatra.

label: West Kalimantan, Indonesia
sub: Nationwide hotspot count surged past 154,000 by Aug 11, 2026 (+60% vs July), with West Kalimantan among the worst-hit; schools in Pontianak closed as haze blanketed the city. By Aug 21, more than 285,000 hectares had burned nationwide and authorities threatened legal action against anyone starting open fires as visibility fell to 1-10 meters in parts of Kalimantan.

label: Sarawak, Malaysia
sub: Cross-border haze from Indonesian Borneo wildfires pushed one district to 'very unhealthy' air quality and eight others to 'unhealthy' on Aug 21, prompting closure of nearly 600 schools affecting roughly 200,000 students.

label: Panama Canal
sub: Canal Authority has cut Neopanamax draft limits three times since July — 50→49.5→49→48.5 feet as of Aug 15, 2026 — as Gatun Lake continues to fall; further cuts to 48 ft (Aug 26) and 47.5 ft (Sep 3) are already scheduled.

label: California Central Valley
sub: NWS flagged potential for historic winter storm activity and flooding as El Niño is projected to lock in a split-flow storm track.

label: San Francisco Bay Area
sub: Could see the highest sea levels on record this year from the combination of El Niño, climate change, and extreme tides.

label: Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh
sub: Landslides and flooding in Rohingya refugee camps killed at least 15 and displaced more than 10,000 since early July 2026.

label: Northern Mariana Islands
sub: Super Typhoon Sinlaku made a direct pass as a Category 5 storm on April 12, 2026 — an early sign of the season's intensity.

label: Kenya
sub: National disaster plan activated ahead of anticipated heavy October-December short rains linked to the El Niño/positive IOD combination. Kenya Met warned Aug 21 that El Niño rains could arrive earlier than usual in parts of the country, with above-normal August-October rainfall over the west raising flash-flood and lake-backflow displacement risk.

label: Southern/Southwestern Somalia
sub: 60% chance of above-average rainfall assessed by FEWS NET, raising flood risk atop an existing crisis affecting 4.8 million people. SoDMA rallied diaspora support and secured Somali Air Force backing for rescue operations in hard-to-reach areas as preparedness intensified through mid-August, with more than 274,000 people on the Shabelle floodplain flagged as most at risk.

label: Ethiopia / Horn of Africa
sub: Biphasic pattern: June-September drought curtails planting in western unimodal zones ahead of a possible October-December deluge.

label: Punjab, India
sub: Among the hardest-hit Indian states in the 2026 monsoon rainfall deficit, compounding the national 40% shortfall.

label: Delhi, India
sub: Recorded steep monsoon rainfall deficits alongside the April-May 2026 record pre-monsoon heatwave.

label: Ivory Coast Cocoa Belt
sub: West Africa supplies nearly 70% of global cocoa; El Niño's dry, hot conditions threaten the October 2026 main crop.

label: Vietnam Central Highlands
sub: Robusta coffee belt vulnerable to El Niño-linked drought after a 2025-26 crop already hit by historic flooding and saltwater intrusion.

label: Sydney / Eastern Australia
sub: AFAC's Aug 19 spring outlook flagged elevated bushfire risk across nearly every Australian state and territory except the ACT, citing dry eastern conditions and high fuel loads ahead of the intensifying El Niño.

label: Albany, New York, US
sub: Storm shattered Albany's all-time two-day rainfall record and killed at least two people amid a summer of repeated Northeast flash flood emergencies.

label: Gulf Coast, US (New Orleans)
sub: NWS flagged structurally elevated flood risk across the Gulf Coast as the Super El Niño locks in a split-flow storm pattern for winter 2026-27.
